items.title: feat(dashscope): derive protocol bases from one domain
items.body:
## TLDR

Problem this solves:

- One DashScope account exposes OpenAI, Anthropic Messages, and native paths under one domain
- A credential could carry only one base, so operators kept one credential per protocol
- The same API key was duplicated across those credentials

How it solves it:

- One DashScope base derives the OpenAI, Anthropic, and native bases
- The credential can store just `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com`
- A native Messages config forwards `/v1/messages` to `/apps/anthropic`
- Messages auth uses only DashScope keys or caller headers

## User Flow

Before: a DashScope account needs one credential per API surface, and the same key is stored twice

1. The admin creates a chat credential with `api_base` `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1`
2. The admin creates a Claude Code credential with `api_base` `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
3. Both credentials store the same DashScope key, so a rotation updates both
4. Chat against the Anthropic credential targets `.../apps/anthropic/chat/completions` and fails

After: one credential with the domain root serves every surface

1. The admin creates one credential with `api_base` `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com`
2. A deployment uses `model: dashscope/qwen3.7-plus` and that credential
3. `POST /v1/chat/completions` returns 200 and the upstream base is the root
4. `POST /v1/messages` returns 200 with `stop_reason: end_turn`

## Pre-Submission checklist

- [x] I have added meaningful tests
- [x] The handful of test files covering my change pass locally, `509 passed`
- [x] My PR passes all required CI/CD checks
- [x] My PR's scope is as isolated as possible
- [x] I have received a Greptile Confidence Score of at least 4/5

## Screenshots / Proof of Fix

Shared setup: dev gateway, one credential `Dashscope-Qwen-Bailian` with `api_base` `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com`, one deployment per surface with `model: dashscope/...`

### Before (66c8f5b1a9)

#### One base for chat and messages

1. Chat credential stores `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1`
2. Claude Code credential stores `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
3. Both credentials store the same DashScope key
4. `POST /v1/chat/completions` against the Anthropic credential appends `/chat/completions` to `/apps/anthropic` and returns a provider error

### After (a005ff9b217)

#### Chat and messages share one credential

1. `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `model: dashscope-unified-test` returns 200, `content: ok`, `x-litellm-model-api-base: https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com`
2. `POST /v1/messages` with the same model returns 200, `content: [{"type":"text","text":"ok"}]`, `stop_reason: end_turn`

#### Embeddings, rerank, image, and video

1. `POST /v1/embeddings` returns 200, 2 vectors of 1024 dimensions
2. `POST /v1/rerank` returns 200, indexes 0 and 2, 52 billed tokens
3. `POST /v1/images/generations` returns 200, 1024x1024 PNG, artifact returns 200 and 916 KB
4. `POST /v1/videos` returns 200 and completes, 5.039s 1280x720 H.264 MP4, 4.4 MB

## Type

New Feature

## Caveats

### Low
- The auth guard is covered by unit tests, the live dev run used the equivalent internal commit before it

- The Before leg was not replayed against the old image because the dev gateway had already rolled to the new build. The dev run used the internal commit `79cf232f`, which differs from this tip only in the upstream import path and URL join helper
- Trial, token-plan, and coding-plan domains are excluded until their path rules are verified
- A base with an unrecognized host or path is left unchanged

## Final Attestation

- [x] The tests check the right things, including the edge cases, and regressions in the respective real-world customer use-cases are not possible after this PR

items.title: feat(providerconfig): add spec.endpoints to override service endpoints
items.body:
> **Depends on #167.** This branch is stacked on #167's head, so until #167 merges the diff here includes all of #167. The change in this PR is the single commit 62f6d70.

## What

Adds `spec.endpoints` to the `v1beta1` `ProviderConfig`: a map keyed by the Terraform provider's endpoint names that overrides the API endpoint used for a service.

```yaml
spec:
  endpoints:
    location: location.aliyuncs.com   # resolve endpoints from mainland China
    vpc: vpc-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com   # private (VPC) endpoint
```

- **`location`** chooses the Location service, which resolves every endpoint not set explicitly.
- **A service key** such as `vpc`, `slb` or `log` (Simple Log Service) pins that service's endpoint.

The map is merged over the provider's defaults, so a key set here always wins.

## Why

#167 makes the provider ask `location-readonly.aliyuncs.com` first, which is served from outside mainland China, and pins the SLS endpoint to work around an upstream cache-key bug. Those defaults fixed timeouts seen from CI runners outside China, but they are hard-coded. This PR makes them configurable per ProviderConfig. It also lets users reach services through private (VPC) endpoints, which there was no way to do before.

## Validation

Keys are checked against the upstream provider's `endpoints` schema, about 160 names. An unknown key or an empty value is reported as an invalid `ProviderConfig` naming the offending keys, instead of failing the provider's configure on every reconcile.

## Changes

- `apis/v1beta1/types.go`: new optional `Endpoints map[string]string`; deep-copy and the ProviderConfig CRD regenerated.
- `internal/clients/alibabacloud.go`: merge `spec.endpoints` over the defaults; validate keys and values.
- `examples/providerconfig/v1beta1/providerconfig-endpoints.yaml` and a "Service Endpoints" section in the README.

The change is additive and optional, so existing ProviderConfigs are unaffected. The client cache from #167 keys on the full configuration, so changing `spec.endpoints` takes effect on the next reconcile.

## Testing

- Unit tests cover the merge, validation (unknown keys, empty values, no endpoints, nil ProviderConfig), and that a merged configuration survives the real upstream provider schema.
- `go test -race ./internal/clients/` and `go vet` pass; the monolith builds.

items.title: Fix: react-insecure-request (server/notification-providers/aliyun-sms.js)
items.body:
## cobalt2 — verified remediation

Fixes `react-insecure-request` at `server/notification-providers/aliyun-sms.js:70`.

### What changed
Changed the Aliyun SMS API endpoint from http:// to https:// so requests are encrypted.

### Why this fix is correct
Before the change, the request config used `url: "http://dysmsapi.aliyuncs.com/"`, so the AccessKeyId, signature, phone numbers and message text went over the network unencrypted. After the change it uses `url: "https://dysmsapi.aliyuncs.com/"`. Axios now sends the request over TLS and checks the server's certificate, so anyone on the network can no longer read or change the request.

### Behavior preserved
The host, path, method, headers, form body and signature are all unchanged. Aliyun's HMAC-SHA1 signature covers only the request parameters, not the URL scheme, so it stays valid. dysmsapi.aliyuncs.com accepts HTTPS, and the proxy setup from getAxiosConfigWithProxy still applies. I didn't run any tests or send a live request.

### Verification
| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Exactly one file changed | ✅ pass |
| Changed file parse (node --check) | ✅ pass |
| Finding's rule no longer fires in changed files | ✅ pass |

items.title: feat(usage): query Qwen Token Plan and Bailian Coding Plan usage via Aliyun AK/SK
items.body:
Ready for review — happy to split or narrow this if you'd rather land one plan first.

## Problem

Two Aliyun coding plans had no usage query in cc-switch, so the provider card stayed blank:

* **Qwen Token Plan** — `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com` (also `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com`)
* **Bailian Coding Plan** — `coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com`

Neither `src/config/codingPlanProviders.ts` nor `detect_provider()` in `src-tauri/src/services/coding_plan.rs` knew these hosts, hence no usage script was injected. Related: #7484.

Their plan key (`sk-sp-...`) only authorizes inference; quota sits behind the console gateway, so an API key alone can never read it.

## Approach

Mirror the official `modelstudio` CLI (`auth:"console"` commands): one shared chain, one per-plan final call.

```
1) POST https://modelstudio.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/modelstudio/cli/generateAccessToken
   ACS3-HMAC-SHA256 signed with the user's Aliyun AK/SK          -> cliAccessToken
2) POST https://bailian-cs.console.aliyun.com/cli/api.json?action=BroadScopeAspnGateway
   Authorization: Bearer cliAccessToken
   - Token Plan   api=zeldaHttp.apikeyMgr./tokenplan/personal/api/v2/usage
       -> per1MonthPercentage (0..1) / per1MonthResetTime
          (per5Hour* / per1Week* are rendered too when an older response carries them)
   - Coding Plan  api=zeldaEasy.broadscope-bailian.codingPlan.queryCodingPlanInstanceInfoV2
       data: {commodityCode: "sfm_codingplan_public_cn", onlyLatestOne: true}
       -> codingPlanInstanceInfos[status=VALID].codingPlanQuotaInfo
          per5Hour / perWeek / perBillMonth x {UsedQuota, TotalQuota, QuotaNextRefreshTime}
```

* New provider ids `qwen_token_plan` and `bailian` in the frontend route table and the backend enum. Host matching covers the three CN hosts above; pay-as-you-go (`dashscope.aliyuncs.com`), `dashscope-intl` and the international token-plan hosts deliberately do not match, since their console gateway differs and is unverified.
* Reuses the existing `volc_hmac_sha256` / `volc_sha256_hex` / `volc_uri_encode` / `VolcCall` primitives — no new dependencies, no new error channel.
* The console token is fetched per query (no cache); a bad signature surfaces as an explicit error instead of an empty card.
* Plan key and AK/SK are separate credentials. The usage modal shows the Aliyun AccessKey fields for these two providers (shared panel with Volcengine, different hint/placeholder/link) and links the RAM console.

## Limitations / follow-ups

* Permanent AK/SK only — no STS (`x-acs-security-token`) support.
* AK/SK are stored with the usage script and therefore synced via WebDAV like other credentials; docs recommend a RAM sub-account limited to `modelstudio:GenerateCLIAccessToken`.
* International sites not handled (`*.alibabacloud.com`, `dashscope-intl`, `sfm_codingplan_public_intl`).
* ACS3 canonicalization is pinned by a unit test against the documented canonical string, but has not been exercised against a live Aliyun account in this PR.
* The console gateway is undocumented; if Aliyun changes it, both plans break together (same code path).

## Testing

* `tsc --noEmit`, `vitest run`, `prettier --check`, `rustfmt --check` — green.
* New Rust unit tests: ACS3 canonical request, gateway error extraction, console-envelope unwrapping, and tier mapping for both plans (incl. `TotalQuota = 0` meaning unlimited → tier skipped).
* CI on the branch is green on all jobs (Frontend Checks + Backend on ubuntu / macOS / Windows, including `cargo fmt --check`, `clippy -D warnings`, nextest).

items.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Model Studio compatible-mode requests (`qwen`, `qwencloud`, `modelstudio`, `dashscope`, `qwen-token-plan`, and `bailian-token-plan`) send the output cap as `max_completion_tokens`. Alibaba's OpenAI-compatibility reference documents `max_tokens` for that surface and does not list `max_completion_tokens`, so the configured cap can be ignored or the request can be rejected.

## Why This Change Was Made

`resolveOpenAICompletionsCompatDefaults` already treats this family as Model Studio for other flags, but `usesMaxTokens` omitted it and fell through to the OpenAI field. The fix adds that family only when the base URL is an Alibaba compatible-mode host (`*.dashscope*.aliyuncs.com` or `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` with a `/compatible-mode/` path).

Coding Plan hosts stay on `max_completion_tokens`. That surface shares the `modelstudio-native` endpoint class, and the cited reference does not cover it. Explicit `model.compat.maxTokensField` still wins. OpenAI and the other vendors that already select `max_tokens` or `max_completion_tokens` are unchanged. Unrelated `/compatible-mode/` proxy URLs are unchanged.

## User Impact

Compatible-mode Model Studio calls now send the configured output budget as `max_tokens`. A budget stored as `params.max_completion_tokens` is still honored; only the wire field changes. Coding Plan, OpenAI, and other providers keep their current field. No config migration is required.

## Evidence

On head `ecdd7b81ce7a9740b097340d0b336fb64134040c` (rebased onto current `upstream/main`):

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run packages/ai/src/transports/openai-completions-params.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.compat.test.ts packages/ai/src/transports/openai-completions-transport.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests  81 passed (81)
```

Live transport proof did not call Model Studio, OpenAI, or Coding Plan. A local HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` received the raw POST body from `streamOpenAICompletionsRequest` in managed mode. Host classification came from `resolveProviderRequestCapabilities` (plugin metadata). The fetch hook refused every hostname except the three proof hosts and forwarded only the request body to that local server. No provider key was read or sent.

1. Model Studio compatible-mode (`qwen`, `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, classified `modelstudio-native` / `modelstudio`) sent `max_tokens` and not `max_completion_tokens`.
2. OpenAI (`openai`, `https://api.openai.com/v1`, classified `openai-public` / `openai-family`) sent `max_completion_tokens`.
3. Coding Plan (`qwen`, `https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1`, classified `modelstudio-native` / `modelstudio`) sent `max_completion_tokens`.

The redacted bodies are in the PR comment on this head. Vendor acceptance of the field was not observed. The field choice follows https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/compatibility-of-openai-with-dashscope

Fixes openclaw/openclaw#127119

items.title: dns_aliesa: add Alibaba Cloud ESA DNS API support
items.body:
## New DNS API: Alibaba Cloud ESA (dns_aliesa)

Adds `dnsapi/dns_aliesa.sh` for Alibaba Cloud ESA (Edge Security Acceleration) DNS.

### Options
| Variable | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AliESA_Key` | yes | API Key |
| `AliESA_Secret` | yes | API Secret |
| `AliESA_Endpoint` | no | API endpoint, default `https://esa.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/`. Use `https://esa.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/` for the China site. |

### Behavior
- `dns_aliesa_add` creates a TXT record; every challenge value gets its own record, so `example.com` + `*.example.com` (two TXT values on the same name) works.
- `dns_aliesa_rm` lists records for the exact name and deletes the record whose TXT value matches; a record that is already gone is not an error.
- IDN domains are converted to punycode with `_idn` before signing.
- Requests use the Aliyun RPC HMAC-SHA1 signature (sorted parameters, RFC 3986 encoding).

### Verification
- `shellcheck -e SC2181 -e SC2089` passes, `shfmt -i 2` is clean.
- Request signatures were compared with an independent implementation for ListSites, CreateRecord, ListRecords and DeleteRecord.
- Local smoke tests cover add, rm, a custom endpoint without trailing slash, and removal of a value that is not in the zone.

DNS-API-Test: running on my fork, the run link will be posted below.

Bug reports: https://github.com/acmesh-official/acme.sh/issues/7357

The `dnsapi2#dns_aliesa` wiki section is prepared; I do not have wiki write access, so it can be pasted in by a maintainer or I can open it if access is granted.

items.title: [bug]: auth login — workspace sk-ws- key + *.maas.aliyuncs.com always fails validation (probes /api/v1/models → 404, misreported as an invalid key)
items.body:
### CLI version

2.5.1

### Skill version (optional)

2.5.1

### Node version

v24.10.0

### OS

darwin 27.0.0 (macOS 27.0.1, arm64)

### Region

intl

### Command to reproduce

```shell
# Official one-line bootstrap copied verbatim from the Bailian console for a
# Singapore (ap-southeast-1) Model Studio workspace. Key + workspace id redacted.
curl -fsSL 'https://bailian.aliyun.com/api-key.sh' | bash -s -- \
  'o1_[REDACTED]' -r ap-southeast-1 -w ws-[REDACTED]
# Steps [1/3] install CLI and [2/3] install skills succeed; [3/3] always fails.

# The bootstrap locally decodes the o1_ blob into an sk-ws-... key, then runs:
bl auth login --config default \
  --api-key 'sk-ws-[REDACTED]' \
  --base-url 'https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com' \
  --verbose

# The wrong probe path is visible even without a valid key:
bl auth login \
  --api-key 'sk-dummy0000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000' \
  --base-url 'https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com' \
  --verbose
```

### Expected behavior

`bl auth login` should accept this key. The very same key against the very same base URL succeeds when the OpenAI-compatible path is used:

```
GET https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/models
→ HTTP 200
  {"object":"list","data":[{"id":"qwen3.8-omni-flash",...},{"id":"glm-5.3",...}, ...]}
```

Workspace gateways at `https://{workspace}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` only serve `/compatible-mode/v1/*`, so login validation should probe `/compatible-mode/v1/models` for them.

### Actual behavior

Validation probes the DashScope-native path instead, gets a 404, and reports it as an **authentication** failure (exit code 3). No config is written, so a subsequent `bl auth status` says "Not authenticated" even though the key is fine.

```
GET https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1
→ HTTP 404 Not Found (empty body)
```

### Root cause (bl 2.5.1, minified names)

**1.** `getApiKeyLoginKind()` (bailian-cli-core) classifies purely by prefix:

```js
function Ft(e){
  let t = e.trim();
  return t.startsWith('sk-sp-') ? 'token-plan'
       : t.startsWith('sk-')    ? 'ordinary'
       :                          'unknown';
}
```

A workspace key `sk-ws-...` therefore lands in **`ordinary`**.

**2.** `Ko(base, kind)` (bailian-cli-commands) picks the models path from the kind:

```js
function Ko(e, t){
  let n = new URL(t === 'token-plan' ? '/compatible-mode/v1/models' : '/api/v1/models', `${e}/`);
  if (t === 'ordinary') { n.searchParams.set('page_no','1'); n.searchParams.set('page_size','1'); }
  return n.toString();
}
```

**3.** Because `--base-url` was passed explicitly, `Xo()` short-circuits (`if (t.explicitBaseUrl) { ...; return i; }`) and never falls back to the `Go.ordinary` public DashScope endpoints — so exactly one candidate is probed, and it is the wrong path.

**4.** `404` is a member of the "endpoint responded" set `Uo = new Set([200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 405])`, so the routing failure is swallowed by `Zo()` and re-thrown as the generic `AUTH` error "the key was not accepted by any supported model endpoint."

Note also that `Xo()` auto-builds `https://{workspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` for all six regions in `Wo` whenever `workspace_id` is configured — always with kind `ordinary`, i.e. always against `/api/v1/models`. So that discovery path is guaranteed to 404 as well. The CLI clearly intends to support these hosts but pairs them with an API path they do not serve.

**Consequence:** any workspace-scoped `sk-ws-` key combined with a `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` base URL can never pass `bl auth login`, in any region, regardless of network conditions. The official console bootstrap command therefore always fails at step [3/3].

### Full output

```shell
> GET https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1
> Auth: sk-w...3-hc
> x-dashscope-source-config: {"channel":"bailian-cli","tags":{"t1":"public","t2":"bl","t3":"2.5.1"}}
< 404 Not Found
request_id: a62006a2-3979-938e-8121-ee8de07d69c9

Error:       API key validation failed: the key was not accepted by any supported model endpoint.
Hint:        Check that the API key belongs to this Base URL.

             bl auth login --api-key <your-key>
             bl auth status
             Get API Key: https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/?tab=app#/api-key
Exit code:   3

--- as surfaced by the api-key.sh bootstrap wrapper ---

[3/3] Configuring credentials

Error: Bailian CLI authentication failed:
Error:       API key validation failed: the key was not accepted by any supported model endpoint.
Hint:        Check that the API key belongs to this Base URL.
Exit code:   3
```

### JSON error (optional)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 3,
    "message": "API key validation failed: the key was not accepted by any supported model endpoint.",
    "hint": "Check that the API key belongs to this Base URL."
  }
}
```

### Already tried

- [x] bl update and skill version aligned with CLI
- [ ] bl auth status OK for this command
- [ ] Different network / region — still reproduces

### How often does this happen?

Always

### How was bl invoked?

Terminal (manual)

### Notes (optional)

### Evidence that this is not a credential, region or network problem

All probes from the same machine, same session. `[REDACTED]` = the real `sk-ws-...` key; workspace id redacted.

| # | Probe | Result |
| - | ----- | ------ |
| 1 | DNS / TCP / TLS to `ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com` | resolves, connect 0.26 s, TLS 0.46 s → network fine |
| 2 | `GET {base}/compatible-mode/v1/models` with the real key | **200**, real model list → **the key is valid for this workspace** |
| 3 | `GET {base}/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1` with the real key | **404**, empty body, request_id `a62006a2-3979-938e-8121-ee8de07d69c9` |
| 4 | `GET {base}/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1` with a deliberately invalid key | **401 Unauthorized**, request_id `a2772a00-991d-95e6-9566-fe85503f391c` |
| 5 | `GET https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1` with the real key | **200** (`total: 170`) |
| 6 | `GET https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/models?page_no=1&page_size=1` with the real key | 401 `InvalidApiKey` — expected, this is an international/Singapore workspace |
| 7 | `GET https://token-plan.{cn-beijing,ap-southeast-1}.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/models` with the real key | 401 `InvalidApiKey` → not a Token Plan key |

Rows 3 and 4 are the decisive pair: the gateway authenticates first and routes second. An invalid key yields 401; a **valid** key yields 404 on that path — i.e. `/api/v1/models` is simply not served on a workspace MaaS gateway. Row 2 confirms the key and workspace are correct. Row 5 explains why the `ordinary` classification is not unreasonable in general: the public intl endpoint does serve the native path. The bug only bites on `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` hosts.

Also worth noting: a genuinely broken network would **not** produce this message. `Qo()` rethrows the first candidate error for which `Zo()` is false (no `api.httpStatus`), so a DNS/TLS/timeout failure surfaces as a network error. Seeing "not accepted by any supported model endpoint" already implies the endpoint answered — which makes the message actively misleading in the 404 case.

### Workaround (bypasses the validation path entirely)

```shell
bl config set --key api_key      --value 'sk-ws-...'
bl config set --key base_url     --value https://ws-[REDACTED].ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com
bl config set --key workspace_id --value ws-[REDACTED]
bl auth status              # → API key (model): config  sk-w...
bl text chat --message hi   # → normal completion through the workspace gateway
```

`bl config set` performs no validation, and real model calls go through `/compatible-mode/v1/...`, so only the login self-check is affected. Confirmed working on 2.5.1.

No spelling of `--base-url` can work around this, because `Ko()` uses `new URL('/api/v1/models', base + '/')` and an absolute path replaces whatever path the user supplied (e.g. a base URL ending in `/compatible-mode/v1`).

Omitting `--base-url` entirely does "succeed" — but only because validation then falls through to `Go.ordinary` and finds `https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com` (row 5), silently persisting the public endpoint instead of the workspace gateway the console asked for.

### Suggested fix

1. In `Ko()`, choose the models path by **host**, not only by key kind: any base URL whose hostname ends in `.maas.aliyuncs.com` (or whose path already contains `/compatible-mode`) should be probed at `/compatible-mode/v1/models`.
2. Alternatively, add a `workspace` kind for the `sk-ws-` prefix in `getApiKeyLoginKind()` and map it to the compatible-mode path.
3. Cheap safety net: when the explicit base URL returns 404 on the probed path, retry the other kind's path before concluding the key is invalid.
4. Remove `404` from `Uo`, or at least distinguish it: a 404 on the models endpoint means "this base URL does not serve this API path", not "this key was rejected". Today it produces exit code 3 / `AUTH`, which also makes `api-key.sh` print `Bailian CLI authentication failed` and skip writing `~/.bailian/config.json`.
5. Surface `http_status` and `request_id` in the JSON error for validation failures — the current JSON object has neither, so an agent or CI cannot tell a routing bug from a bad key.

### Related

- #241 (closed) — same family: a wrong default endpoint producing HTTP 404 for every request (`vision describe` pinned to the Coding Plan host).
- #267 (open) — same Singapore workspace `sk-ws-` key + `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` setup, different symptom (local media upload pinned to the China endpoint).

Invoked via the terminal, through the official `https://bailian.aliyun.com/api-key.sh` bootstrap command copied from the Bailian console.

items.title: [feat] 建议整合百炼供应商预设：合并 Bailian Plan 与 Bailian Decision 为统一的 Bailian 供应商
items.body:
### 背景与痛点

目前在「供应商」添加列表中，阿里云百炼被拆分成了两个独立的预设，现状存在较为严重的逻辑混乱与功能割裂：

1. **功能重叠与语义割裂**：
   - 目前存在 `bailian-token-plan`（显示为 Bailian Plan）和 `bailian-decision`（显示为 Bailian Decision）。
   - `bailian-decision` 的 Regions 选项中包含了 `Token Plan · Beijing`，但因为它是按纯决策模型（`DecideOnly`）实现的，**没有配置 Chat / Anthropic 协议**，导致用户即使选了该项，也只能作为路由组分类器，无法在常规 Agent（如 Claude Code、Codex）中对话。
   - 而 `bailian-token-plan` 虽有对话与决策能力，但端点硬编码为北京 Token Plan，不支持 Region 切换，也不支持业务空间。
2. **百炼官方主推的业务空间专属域名在对话场景中缺失**：
   - 阿里云百炼官方文档明确强调：**推荐生产环境迁移至业务空间专属域名**（`https://{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` 和 `/apps/anthropic`）。
   - 但在目前的 Magpie 预设里，业务空间专属域名被错误地局限在纯决策的 `bailian-decision` 中，导致用户想使用百炼官方推荐的业务空间专属域名来进行正常模型对话时，在预设列表中无处可寻。
3. **用户认知负担极重**：
   - Token Plan 用户不知道该选 Bailian Plan 还是 Bailian Decision（里面的 Token Plan 北京）。
   - 业务空间用户想接入 Qwen 模型，发现 Qwen 预设走的是老旧的共享 DashScope 域名，不能填业务空间 ID；而能填业务空间 ID 的 Bailian Decision 却又不能用于对话。

---

### 建议方案

将 `bailian-token-plan` 和 `bailian-decision` 合并为一个统一的供应商预设（例如 ID 为 `ali-bailian` 或 `bailian`）：

1. **统一功能**：预设同时支持 Chat、Anthropic 与 System One Decide。
2. **端点切换（Regions）提供三个清晰选项**：
   - **`业务空间 · 北京` (`Workspace · Beijing`)**
     - Chat: `https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - Anthropic: `https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
     - Decide: `https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - 动态展示「业务空间 ID」输入框，自动替换 `{WorkspaceId}`。
   - **`业务空间 · 新加坡` (`Workspace · Singapore`)**
     - Chat: `https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - Anthropic: `https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
     - Decide: `https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - 动态展示「业务空间 ID」输入框。
   - **`Token Plan · 北京` (`Token Plan · Beijing`)**
     - Chat: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - Anthropic: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
     - Decide: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
     - 隐藏「业务空间 ID」输入框，预设 `alibabaPlanModels`。

---

### 关于「业务空间 / Token Plan」与「地域」是否正交的考量

我们评估过是否应将「模式」和「地域」拆为两个平级的独立字段：
- **概念上两者确实正交**：模式（业务空间按量 / Token Plan 订阅）与地域（北京 / 新加坡 / 等）在逻辑上是两个维度。
- **但云厂商现状存在非对称性**：百炼官方文档显示，业务空间已在多地域部署，而 **Token Plan 目前仅在华北2（北京）上线**（`token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com`），海外尚无端点。
- **设计建议**：
  若拆为两个独立字段，在用户选择「Token Plan + 新加坡」时会产生无效状态，需要额外的联动置灰逻辑。
  因此，参考 Magpie 中 **Xiaomi MiMo**（`Plan · China` / `Plan · Singapore` / `Pay as you go`）与 **Tencent Cloud**（`Plan · China` / `Pay as you go · China` / `Pay as you go · Global`）的既有做法，保持单层的复合选项是目前对用户最直观、对代码侵入最小的做法。

---

### 向后兼容与平滑迁移

可以在 `internal/provider/presets.go` 的 `presetAliases` 中添加别名映射：
```go
var presetAliases = map[string]struct{ preset, region string }{
    "bailian-token-plan": {"bailian", "token-plan"},
    "bailian-decision":   {"bailian", "cn-beijing"},
    // ...
}
```
老用户已保存的供应商可平滑兼容，不影响现有路由组与 Agent 的使用。

items.title: SLS endpoint is cached under "sls" but looked up under "log", so every SLS API call repeats endpoint discovery
items.body:
### Terraform Version

terraform-provider-alicloud v2.0.0, v2.1.0 and `master` (9387124ecdbe7d88b121498d99990e59d328320f).

### Affected Resource(s)

All resources that call Simple Log Service (product code `sls`), for example:

- alicloud_log_project
- alicloud_log_store
- alicloud_log_machine_group

### Terraform Configuration Files

```hcl
provider "alicloud" {
  region = "us-west-1"
}

resource "alicloud_log_project" "default" {
  project_name = "example-sls-endpoint-cache"
}
```

### Expected Behavior

The SLS endpoint is resolved once per provider instance, then served from the
endpoint cache.

### Actual Behavior

Every SLS API call resolves the endpoint again. When the Location service is
slow to reach -- in our case from CI runners outside mainland China -- each
call waits for the two-minute lookup, and reads such as `GetProject`, which
retry for one minute, time out:

```text
[WARN] loading sls endpoint got an error: ... Describe sls endpoint using region: "us-west-1" got an error: &retry.TimeoutError{...}. Using the endpoint us-west-1.log.aliyuncs.com instead.
service_alicloud_sls_v2.go:50: Resource crossplane-example-project-... Failed!!! [SDK alibaba-cloud-sdk-go ERROR]:
timeout while waiting for state to become 'success' (timeout: 1m0s)
```

The `[WARN]` line repeats for every call, not once per run.

### Cause

`loadApiEndpoint` maps `sls` to the config key `log` and checks the cache under
that key first:

https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud/blob/9387124ecdbe7d88b121498d99990e59d328320f/alicloud/connectivity/client.go#L2496-L2513

```go
configEndpoints := productCodeToConfigEndpoints[productCode] // "sls" -> "log"
...
if v, ok := client.config.Endpoints.Load(configEndpoints); !ok || v.(string) == "" {
    if err := client.loadEndpoint(productCode); err != nil { // runs again on every call
```

`loadEndpoint` stores what it resolves -- from the environment, from the
Location service, or from the `regularProductEndpoint` fallback -- under the
product code, `sls`, never under `log`:

https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud/blob/9387124ecdbe7d88b121498d99990e59d328320f/alicloud/connectivity/endpoint.go#L552-L612

So the first `Load("log")` always misses and discovery runs again; the second
`Load("sls")` then finds the value just stored. `sls` is the only entry in
`productCodeToConfigEndpoints`
([endpoint.go#L323-L325](https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud/blob/9387124ecdbe7d88b121498d99990e59d328320f/alicloud/connectivity/endpoint.go#L323-L325)),
so only SLS is affected. Setting `endpoints { log = "..." }` in the provider
block avoids it, because then `Load("log")` hits.

### Suggested Fix

Either store the resolved endpoint under the key `loadApiEndpoint` reads:

```go
key := productCode
if v, ok := productCodeToConfigEndpoints[productCode]; ok {
    key = v
}
client.config.Endpoints.Store(key, endpoint)
```

or have `loadApiEndpoint` check `Load(productCode)` before calling
`loadEndpoint`.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `terraform apply` with the configuration above from a network where
   `location.aliyuncs.com` is slow or unreachable, with `TF_LOG=WARN`.
2. Observe `loading sls endpoint got an error` logged on every SLS call.

With a healthy network the extra lookups are quick, so the bug only costs
time; with a slow Location service it makes SLS reads fail.

### Important Factoids

Found while running the provider's resource code from the Crossplane provider
for Alibaba Cloud in CI outside mainland China, where it reconciles resources
continuously, so the repeated lookups were very visible.

Related, separate suggestion: `describeEndpointForService` asks
`location.aliyuncs.com` first and switches to `location-readonly.aliyuncs.com`
only after a timeout
([endpoint.go#L652-L700](https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud/blob/9387124ecdbe7d88b121498d99990e59d328320f/alicloud/connectivity/endpoint.go#L652-L700)).
From outside mainland China, `location-readonly.aliyuncs.com` answers far
faster, and products with no `regularProductEndpoint` fallback (for example
`slb`, `polardb`) fail outright when the first endpoint times out. Asking the
read-only endpoint first, or making the order configurable, would help users
outside China. Setting `endpoints { location = "location-readonly.aliyuncs.com" }`
works around it today.

### References

None found; no existing issue or PR mentions it.

fix(dashscope): support separate responses_api_base for MaaS workspace URLs
items.body:
Fixes #38474

### Problem
DashScope MaaS workspace endpoints host Chat Completions and Responses API on completely different base paths:
- Chat: `https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- Responses: `https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/api/v2/apps/protocols/compatible-mode/v1`

Using a single `api_base` causes `/v1/responses` calls to 404 on MaaS endpoints.

### Solution
- Added `DashScopeResponsesAPIConfig` resolving `responses_api_base` (in `litellm_params`) and `DASHSCOPE_RESPONSES_API_BASE` (env var) with fallback to `api_base` / `DASHSCOPE_API_BASE`.
- Preserved prompt `cache_control` tags matching `DashScopeChatConfig`.
- Added unit tests covering MaaS workspace base URLs, env var precedence, and fallback paths.

labels.name: risk/high

items.body:
Fixes #8578

## Why

I run OpenDesign self-hosted (Docker, BYOK agent) with the Custom Image API provider pointed at Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian compatible-mode). Every reference-image generation failed while text-to-image on the same endpoint worked fine: `renderCustomOpenAIImage` posts reference images as JSON to `<base>/images/edits`, and Model Studio publishes no `/images/edits` route — the provider answers a body-less 404, which surfaces to the user as the undiagnostic `custom image 404: ` and pushes the agent onto `switch-model`, where it fails again on other providers' missing credentials (issue #8578 has the full capture, plus a working sidecar comparison that proves the request shape is the only gap).

This PR follows the maintainer guidance on the issue: it adds the Model Studio generations-plus-`image` path as a deterministic host-based route selection, with no retry-after-404 fallback — retrying image requests can duplicate billable work, so nothing is attempted twice.

## What users will see

- **Model Studio users**: attaching a reference image to a custom-image generation now works. The reference goes to `/images/generations` as a top-level `image` field (URL or `data:` base64 URI) — the request shape Model Studio documents for I2I. No new setting, no UI change: detection is purely by base-URL host (`*.maas.aliyuncs.com`, `dashscope.aliyuncs.com`, `dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com`).
- **Everyone else**: nothing changes. The generic `/images/edits` JSON path is byte-for-byte identical and stays pinned by the existing `routes custom-image reference-image requests through /v1/images/edits` regression test.

Verified live against a Model Studio workspace before opening this PR: t2i (1024×1024) and i2i (1792×1024, faithfully reproducing a reference logo) both succeed end-to-end through the daemon dispatch path.

## Surface area

- [ ] **UI** — new page / dialog / panel / menu item / setting / empty state in `apps/web` or `apps/desktop` (including Electron menu bar)
- [ ] **Keyboard shortcut** — new or changed
- [ ] **CLI / env var** — new `od` subcommand or flag, new `tools-dev` / `tools-pack` flag, or new `OD_*` env var
- [ ] **API / contract** — new `/api/*` endpoint, new SSE event, or changed shape in `packages/contracts`
- [ ] **Extension point** — new entry under `skills/`, `design-systems/`, `design-templates/`, or `craft/`, or change to the skills protocol
- [ ] **i18n keys** — added new translation keys (see `TRANSLATIONS.md` for the locale workflow)
- [ ] **New top-level dependency** — adding any new entry to the **root** `package.json` (`dependencies` or `devDependencies`); workspace-package `package.json` files are out of scope. Include a paragraph on what we get vs. what bytes we ship (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` → Code style)
- [x] **Default behavior change** — changes what existing users experience without opting in (default model, default setting, file/SQLite schema, auto-network on startup, auto-install)
- [ ] **None** — internal refactor, docs, tests, or translation update only

(Default-behavior note: the only behavioral change is for base URLs on Model Studio hosts, where reference-image requests previously always failed with a body-less 404. All other providers take the exact same code path as before, locked by the existing regression test.)

## Screenshots

No UI surface. (Generated-output evidence lives in issue #8578: the i2i output reproduces the reference monogram on a white 16:9 canvas.)

## Bug fix verification

- Test path that reproduces the bug: `apps/daemon/tests/media/openai-compatible-providers.test.ts` — the new Model Studio fixtures: the workspace-host test, a table-driven `it.each` over all four legacy DashScope hosts from Alibaba's base-URL table (`dashscope`, `dashscope-intl`, `dashscope-us`, `cn-hongkong.dashscope`), and a negative fixture proving arbitrary `*.aliyuncs.com` hosts keep the generic `/images/edits` path.
- Did the test go red on `main` and green on this branch? **Yes.** On unfixed `main` both fail because the request goes to the edits route:
  `Expected: "https://…/compatible-mode/v1/images/generations" — Received: "https://…/compatible-mode/v1/images/edits"` (2 failed | 10 passed).
  On the first branch head, the `dashscope-us` and `cn-hongkong.dashscope` cases (the two hosts this PR originally missed) also went red before the classifier fixup; on the current head: 16/16 pass in the file, and the full `tests/media/` suite is green (28 files, 255/255), including the untouched `/images/edits` regression test.

- `pnpm typecheck` — pass (full recursive workspace typecheck + `tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit`)

items.title: [hub-mirror] nodejs
Add Qwen Cloud Token Plan as a built-in provider preset
items.body:
### Problem Statement

Built-in `dashscope-tokenplan` is China-only (`https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`). Qwen Cloud Token Plan (Singapore) uses `https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` and a dedicated `sk-sp-` key.

Mixing that key with `dashscope` (`sk-` / `sk-ws-` + `dashscope.aliyuncs.com`) bills pay-as-you-go. Users can already point a custom provider at the Singapore URL; a preset makes the official pair one TUI/CLI choice so `ocr config provider` / `--provider qwen-cloud` works without a custom entry.

### Proposed Solution

Add a built-in provider `qwen-cloud`:

- Protocol: `openai` (`ProtocolOpenAIChatCompletions`)
- Base URL: `https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- Env var: `QWEN_CLOUD_API_KEY`
- Same request path as `dashscope-tokenplan` (existing OpenAI Chat Completions client)
- Same Token Plan model catalog as the current `dashscope-tokenplan` entry

`ocr config provider` / `ocr llm test` should work without a custom provider entry.

### Alternatives Considered

- Override `providers.dashscope-tokenplan.url` — works, but easy to forget and still hit Beijing.
- Custom provider — already works, but not a first-class TUI/CLI choice.
- Coding Plan presets (`coding.dashscope` / `coding-intl`) — different hosts; tracked by #1388.
- Anthropic-compatible twin (`https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`) — a second preset; later PR.

### Affected Area

- Configuration
- Documentation
- CLI / Commands

### Additional Context

Official OpenAI URL from the [Qwen Cloud Token Plan quickstart](https://docs.qwencloud.com/token-plan/personal/token-plan-personal-quickstart).

Related but distinct: #1388 is Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan, not Token Plan International (Singapore). This request is only the OpenAI-compatible Singapore Token Plan endpoint.

items.body:
## Why

ElevenLabs' premade voices read Mandarin with a noticeable foreign accent, and its native-Mandarin library voices return `402 paid_plan_required` over the API on free accounts. Aliyun Bailian's Qwen3-TTS ships native Mandarin voices to every account, which fits the default 王总局 scenario better.

## What changed

- `TTS_PROVIDER=aliyun` selects Aliyun Qwen3-TTS; unset (or anything else) keeps ElevenLabs. Explicit switch — never inferred from which keys exist.
- `/api/tts` Aliyun path: `POST {base}/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation` → signed OSS link → download. `parameters.response_format: "mp3"` keeps audio ~4× smaller than the WAV default; `language_type` follows the resolved zh/en locale.
- Security: DashScope returns the OSS link as **plain `http:`**, so the allowlist accepts http/https only for `dashscope-result-*.oss-*.aliyuncs.com` (no credentials, no custom port) and always rewrites the fetch to `https:` with `redirect: 'error'`. The base URL must be https on `*.aliyuncs.com` (workspace endpoints such as `ws-….cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com` are allowed). The generation JSON goes through the bounded `readResponseText`.
- Timeout: 15 s for Aliyun (measured: 17 chars ≈ 1.3 s, 67 chars ≈ 3.7 s, the 260-char ceiling ≈ 12 s); ElevenLabs stays at 5 s. Cache entries now keep the upstream content type, and the provider is part of the cache key.
- Voices: coach `Cherry`, 王总 `Andre`, 小顾 `Ethan`, 林姐 `Katerina`, each overridable via `ALIYUN_TTS_VOICE_*`.
- `provider-status`, `doctor`, footer label (`阿里云语音优先` / `Aliyun voice preferred`), `.env.example`, README (zh/en), DEPLOYMENT (zh/en), ARCHITECTURE and PRIVACY (spoken text goes to Alibaba Cloud when enabled) updated.
- The TTS budget still reads `ELEVENLABS_TTS_BUDGET_UNITS_PER_100_CHARS` for both providers; renaming it is left for a follow-up to keep this PR focused.

Verified live in a production build: Aliyun `200 audio/mpeg` for coach and character lines, and with `TTS_PROVIDER=elevenlabs` the ElevenLabs path still returns `200 audio/mpeg`.

Independent of #55; both add a line under `CHANGELOG.md › Unreleased`, so whichever merges second needs a one-line conflict resolution.

- [x] Typecheck, lint, unit tests and relevant E2E tests pass (186 unit tests incl. Aliyun success, http→https upgrade, disallowed host, missing URL, missing key, default-provider regression; `npm run build` passes; E2E not run)

- [ ] Accessibility and mobile/touch behavior were considered — n/a (captions and browser-speech fallback unchanged)
- [x] Breaking changes and migration steps are documented — none; ElevenLabs remains the default

items.title: [bug] International site: console commands still report NotLogined after AK/SK auto-refresh (GenerateCLIAccessToken token rejected)
items.body:
## Environment
- `bl` 1.20.0, macOS
- Alibaba Cloud **international** account, console gateway `ap-southeast-1` / `international`
- Profile: `token-plan` (base_url `https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com`)
- Credentials: RAM user (Permanent AccessKey only) with `AliyunBailianFullAccess`

## Expected (per #95)
After `bl auth login --open-api`, a console command that hits `NotLogined` silently refreshes the access token from AK/SK and retries successfully.

## Actual
The refresh runs and `GenerateCLIAccessToken` returns 200 with a `cliAccessToken`, but the retried console call still fails with `Console session is not logged in or has expired.` (exit 3). Every console command is affected (`usage token-plan`, `usage free`, `workspace list`).

Two separate problems observed:

### 1. Region resolution falls back to `cn` for non-DashScope base URLs
`packages/core/src/auth/refresh-token.ts` → `resolveRegion()` only matches the three `REGIONS` DashScope URLs. A `token-plan` profile (`*.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com`) doesn't match, so the refresh goes to `modelstudio.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com` for an international account.

```
> POST https://bailian-singapore-cs.alibabacloud.com/cli/api.json?action=IntlBroadScopeAspnGateway&...
< 200
Refreshing access token...
> POST https://modelstudio.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/modelstudio/cli/generateAccessToken
< 200 OK
> POST https://bailian-singapore-cs.alibabacloud.com/cli/api.json?...
< 200
Error:       Console session is not logged in or has expired.
```

### 2. Even with the correct intl host, the token is rejected
To rule out (1) I created a profile with `base_url=https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com`, `console_site=international`, `console_region=ap-southeast-1`, then `bl auth login --open-api`. The refresh now hits `modelstudio.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com` and gets a token, but the intl console gateway still answers NotLogined for all console commands.

So on the international site the token produced by `GenerateCLIAccessToken` does not appear to be accepted by `IntlBroadScopeAspnGateway` (at least for a RAM user). Is there a required RAM permission / workspace membership / site setting for this to work, or is intl not supported yet?

## Side effect worth noting
`bl auth login --open-api` and every failed auto-refresh overwrite `access_token` in `config.json`, which replaces a still-valid browser-login console session with an unusable token. A guard (only overwrite when the new token actually passes a console call) would avoid that.

## Repro
1. International account, RAM user with `AliyunBailianFullAccess`, Permanent AccessKey.
2. `bl auth login --console` (works), then `bl auth login --open-api --access-key-id ... --access-key-secret ...`
3. `bl usage token-plan --verbose` → refresh 200, console still NotLogined.

items.title: feat: add Alibaba OSS provider
items.body:
# Description

Adds native Alibaba Cloud OSS support to the filemanager package for RUD-3357.

- Registers the `ALIBABA_OSS` provider and environment-derived configuration.
- Supports static access keys and RAM role authentication through `credentials-go`.
- Implements upload, multipart file upload, download/ranges, paginated listing, batched deletion, and location parsing.
- Restricts production endpoint overrides to HTTPS `*.aliyuncs.com` hosts and validates scheme-less endpoints before use.
- Sanitizes OSS service errors before returning or logging them.
- Adds fake OSS/STS coverage and opt-in static, role, and long-running refresh live tests.
- Adds direct dependencies on `alibabacloud-oss-go-sdk-v2 v1.6.0` and `credentials-go v1.3.10`; `go mod why` confirms both are imported directly by `filemanager`.

Validation:
- `go test ./filemanager -run 'TestOSS'` - passed
- `go test -short ./filemanager -run 'TestOSS'` - passed
- `go vet ./filemanager` - passed
- `go build ./...` - passed during implementation
- `go vet ./...` - passed during implementation
- `go mod tidy` - passed during implementation
- `git diff --check` - passed

Live tests remain skipped because Alibaba OSS credentials are not available. The PR remains in draft until they are run against the real bucket.

## Linear Ticket

RUD-3357

## Security

- [x] The code changed/added as part of this pull request won't create any security issues with how the software is being used.

Role caller credentials remain in kit configuration rather than destination configuration. Test-only plaintext transport is guarded by an internal test option and documented not to be enabled for customer configurations. Service errors are sanitized to avoid exposing headers, snapshots, or signed query parameters. Role credential lookups are serialized without spawning request-scoped goroutines that could outlive cancellation.

## ⚠️ Known Issues

The broader `go test ./filemanager ./filemanager/...` gate has unrelated baseline/environment failures: existing AWS/S3/GCS tests reject the configured custom RootCA HTTP client, and Azure tests cannot pull the Azurite container. No OSS-focused test failed.
